name: the-operator
description: Study any passage of Scripture in its own context — what the author meant, how you know, and what to do with it.

scripts.mobile:sync: bash scripts/check-mobile-release-provenance.sh && VITE_OPERATOR_RELEASE_STAGE=full VITE_ESV_MOBILE_LICENSED=false npm run build:mobile && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer npx cap sync
